offline_benchmark.label: Offline benchmark only — not live, not deployed

notes: ElasticNet is an offline benchmark only — not deployed, not a live improvement.
SGE is a tested PoC, not a hardware-proven BMS.

This run is NOT real-sensor validation: its source is 'lab_sample_nasa'. Lab-sample cells come from the NASA dataset the model trained on, so these numbers verify the harness and pipeline, not held-out accuracy. Real-sensor validation is pending.
